opportunityName: Custodial Services at East Bay Branch

siteProfile.occupiedHours: Monday and Thursday service window while the library is closed, plus 24/7 emergency response availability

requirements.reportingCadence: Weekly inspection and Facilities Manager check-ins

notes: The official source is the Traverse Area District Library East Bay Branch custodial-services RFP issued February 26, 2026 with bids due March 31, 2026.
The East Bay branch is a small-footprint library site at 1989 Three Mile Road with an estimated 1,200 square feet and a closed-building service window on Monday and Thursday.
The buyer wants trained and supervised staff, 24/7 emergency call-in availability, proof of insurance, a thirty-day out clause, and 3 to 5 references.

The scope includes restroom cleaning, trash and recycling removal, break-area cleaning, wipe-down of public tables and computers, glass touchpoints, and reporting repair issues to the Facilities Manager.
The bidder is expected to furnish chemicals, paper products, soap, sanitizer, trash liners, and equipment while maintaining enough stock to avoid service interruption.
This is a good Boss Key contrast case because it is a smaller public-sector branch location where reliability and completeness matter more than a large multi-site launch story.
